seoTitle: Add Nifty 100 Stocks to Your TradingView Watchlist
metaDescription: Learn how to add all Nifty 100 stocks to your TradingView watchlist using the Stock Screener, and organize them into sections for easier tracking.
intro: Tracking every Nifty 100 company individually would take forever, but TradingView's screener and watchlist tools can speed things up significantly. This guide shows how to find and add Nifty 100 stocks in bulk, filter them using the Stock Screener, and organize your watchlist into clean sections. It's aimed at Indian stock market traders and investors who want the full index in one place.

steps.heading: Search for Nifty 100 stocks
steps.body: Use TradingView's search or screener to locate stocks belonging to the Nifty 100 index.

steps.heading: Use the Stock Screener filter
steps.body: Apply an index filter in the Stock Screener to pull up the full list of Nifty 100 constituents at once.

steps.heading: Add stocks to your watchlist quickly
steps.body: Select multiple stocks from the screener results and add them to your watchlist in bulk rather than one at a time.

steps.heading: Organize your watchlist in sections
steps.body: Create separate sections within your watchlist to group Nifty 100 stocks logically, such as by sector or market cap.

steps.heading: Apply tips to manage large index watchlists
steps.body: Keep your watchlist tidy by periodically reviewing which stocks you're actively tracking versus ones you can archive or remove.

faq.question: Can I add all Nifty 100 stocks at once instead of individually?
faq.answer: Yes, using the Stock Screener with an index filter lets you select and add multiple stocks to your watchlist in bulk.

faq.question: Will TradingView automatically update the list if the Nifty 100 changes?
faq.answer: Index constituents can change periodically, so it's worth checking your watchlist occasionally to make sure it still reflects the current Nifty 100 composition.

faq.question: How can I keep a large watchlist organized?
faq.answer: Using sections to group stocks by sector, sub-index, or strategy can make a large list like the Nifty 100 much easier to navigate.

faq.question: Is the Stock Screener available on all TradingView plans?
faq.answer: Screener access and its filtering capabilities can vary depending on your subscription plan, so check your account for details.
